Prefix with INR: for rupee format  |  Use PCT: for percentage format

🚨 Moisture Deduction Formula

📋 2 Modes available: "Quality Deduction Mode" dropdown se select karo — Per Truck (har truck pe individual) ya Average All (sab trucks ke avg moisture pe ek total deduction).
🚨 PER TRUCK MODE (default)
Ded % = Actual Moisture − Passing (per truck)
Qual.Ded = GRN Wt × (Rate÷1000) × Ded %
Truck moisture 12.84%, passing 10%, GRN 32,990 KG @ ₹17100/MT
Ded% = 2.84% → ₹ 16,009
📊 AVERAGE ALL MODE
Avg Moisture = mean of all truck moistures
Ded % = Avg Moisture − Passing
Total Ded = TOTAL GRN × (Rate÷1000) × Ded %
Passing 11%, avg of 4 trucks = 11.35% → Ded% = 0.35%
Applied on TOTAL GRN (single deduction, not per-truck)

ⓘ If moisture ≤ passing, deduction = 0 (no deduction).
